figures.shows: The whole editor with its panels docked: Hierarchy, Scene view, Inspector, Content Browser and the toolbar with Play. The Crate is selected, and the Inspector shows its Translation.
figures.caption: The editor with the Third Person sample's course open: one window, one program, whose parts come from the interface layer, which draws state the core holds. A crate stands in for the cube; it is selected, so the Inspector shows its position.
figures.alt: The editor window with a list of objects on the left, a 3D scene in the middle, a property panel on the right and a file browser at the bottom. The Crate is selected in the list and in the scene, and the property panel shows its position.
